name: checkout-card-tanstack-i18n
title: Checkout card
author: ViraStack <https://virastack.com>
description: Choose or add a credit card, with the card number and CVV kept off the network.

en.checkout_card_form_description: The card number and CVV never leave this browser. The request carries a dummy token, the brand, the last four digits, the expiry and the name on the card.
en.checkout_card_save_error: Could not save the card. Try again.
en.checkout_card_error_holder: Enter the name on the card

tr.checkout_card_form_description: Kart numarası ve CVV bu tarayıcıdan çıkmaz. İstek dummy token, marka, son dört hane, son kullanma tarihi ve kart üzerindeki adı taşır.
tr.checkout_card_error_expiry_invalid: Geçerli ve ileri bir tarih gir
